simple.meaning: קֶדֶם (qedem) is a Hebrew action word meaning “the front , of place (absolutely, the fore part , relatively the East ) or time ( antiquity ); often used adverbially ( before , anciently , eastward ).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 87 times in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 17 more, beginning at Genesis 2:8. The surrounding contexts include altar, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֶדֶם (H6924) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קֶדֶם (qedem) / H6924 is traced through Genesis 2:8, Genesis 3:24, Genesis 10:30, Genesis 11:2 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H6924. qedem קֶ֫דֶם noun [masculine] front, east, aforetime ; — absolute ׳ק Deut 33:27 +, קֶ֑קֶם Judg 8:10 +; construct קֶדֶם Prov 8:22 ; once plural construct קַדְמֵי 8:23 ; — 1 location a. front , ׳מִקּ Isa 9:11 from the front (i.e. East), in front (opposed to מֵאָחוֺר ), וָק ׳אָחוֺר Psa 139:5 behind and before ; ׳ק אֶהֳלֹךְ Job 23:8 I go forward (opposed to אָחוֺר ) b. East: ׳הַרהַֿקּ Gen 10:30 (J) mount of the East ; ׳בְּנֵיקֿ = dwellers in the east, tribes east or northeast of Canaan 29:1 (E), Judg 6:3 , 33 ; 7:12 ; 8:10 ; 1Kin 5:10 ; Isa 11:14 ; Jer 49:28 ; Ezek 25:4 , 10 ; Job 1:3 ; ק ׳הַרְרֵי Num 23:7 , see Di Sachau: Reise (1883), 159 ff.165 ff. Dr in Hast. PETHOS ; ק ׳אֶרֶץ Gen 25:6 (J); מִקֶּדֶם מָֽלְאוּ Isa 2:6 they are full from the east (insert probably מִקְסָם קֶסֶם, , or < קֹסְמִים before ׳מִקּ , compare Lo De Du Che Hpt Di-Kit); elsewhere ׳מִקּ = eastward: (I) in the east Gen 2:8 (2) on the eastern (side) 12:8 (J) Zech 14:4 ; ׳מִקּ לְ on the east of Gen 3:24 (J), 12:8 (J), Numbers 34: (P), Josh 7:2 (JE), Judg 8:11 ; Ezek 11:23 = Jonah 4:5 ; -3 eastward , with verb of motion Gen 11:2 ; 13:11 (both J). 2 temporal, ancient time, aforetime: a. ק ׳הַרְרֵי Deut 33:15 ancient mountains , compare ק ׳אֱלֹהֵי 33:27 , ׳מַלְכֵיקֿ Isa 19:11 , שְׁמֵיקֿ ׳בִּשְׁמֵי Psa 68:34 . b. ק ׳כִּימֵי Psa 44:2 in ancient days ; compare ק ׳מִימֵי from of old Isa 23:7 ; Micah 7:20 ; Lam 1:7 ; 2:17 ; Isa 37:26 = ק ׳לְמִימֵי ) 2Kin 19:25 (see מִן 9b (2)); ק ׳כִּימֵי Isa 51:9 ; Jer 46:26 ; ק ׳יַרְחֵי Job 29:2 months of old. c. ׳מִקּ from of old Micah 5:1 ; Isa 45:21 ; 46:10 ; Hab 1:12 ; Neh 12:46 ; Psa 77:12 ׳מִנִּיק 7; 8:2 springing out of, derived from, ancient times (compare Dr); מִקּ ׳יָמִים 77:6 ; 143:5 days from of old. d. ׳ק alone, as adverb anciently, of old Psa 74:2 ; 119:152 ; ׳כְּק Jer 30:20 ; Lam 5:21 ; ק ׳ישֵׁב Psa 55:20 he that sitteth (enthroned from) of old. e. beginning , מִקַּדְמֵיאָֿ֑רֶץ Prov 8:23 from the beginnings of the earth ; ׳ק מִפְעָלָיו 8:22 the beginning of his works (|| רֵאשִׁית ). [ קֵ֫דֶם ], with ה locative I. קֵ֫דְמָה adverb eastward, to, toward, the east ; — Gen 25:6 (J), Lev 1:16 ; 16:14 ; Num 34:3 , 11 , 15 ; Josh 19:12-13 , (all P), 1Kin 7:39 2Chr 4:10 ; 1Kin 17:3 = 2Kin 13:17 ; Ezek 8:16 (twice in verse); + north, south, west, Gen 13:14 ; 28:14 (both J), Num 2:3 ; 3:28 ; 10:5 (north, west, in ᵐ5 ), 34:10 (all P); also as noun after מְּאַת = eastern side , Exod 27:13 ; 38:13 (both P), + W Ezek 45:7 (strike out Co; read קֶדֶם Berthol Toy Krae), + north, south, west, Num 35:5 ; Josh 18:20 so ק ׳גְּבוּל 15:5 (all P).
